retired_positive_claims: extension flag opt-in for deferred v1 features
policy.required_replacement: canonical rejection or strict-error metadata with stable diagnostic codes

fixture_shape_policy.negative_cases: own retired spelling, removed flag, retired adapter, alternate acceptance path, retired-source lane, unsupported feature, and strict-error expectations

boundaries.behavior_focus: grammar acceptance, grammar rejection, mode spelling, and source span stability
boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: parser positives use canonical Objective-C 3.0 spellings; retired mode and feature-toggle spellings are diagnostic fixtures

boundaries.behavior_focus: type system, effects, isolation, ownership, and feature gate semantics
boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: semantic positives must prove canonical behavior; deferred or disabled features are strict errors instead of compatibility opt-ins

boundaries.behavior_focus: runtime-facing lowering contracts, ABI metadata, and optimization-invariant behavior
boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: lowering fixtures may assert ABI stability but must not introduce alternate gate ABIs or retired route lowering paths

boundaries.behavior_focus: IR, object, manifest, and registration artifact truth gates
boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: IR and artifact fixtures must expose canonical manifest contracts and reject downgraded or retired route artifact provenance

boundaries.behavior_focus: runnable positive exit-code fixtures and strict compile/link/run rejection sidecars
boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: runtime-like positives are canonical e2e or runtime-probe fixtures only; storage/reflection/public ABI probes anchor current owners, while unresolved runtime dispatch, unsupported feature claims, and compatibility-looking names stay negative or get renamed

boundaries.behavior_focus: textual interface emission, module metadata preservation, and verifier drift diagnostics
boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: round-trip fixtures preserve canonical metadata and reject missing or downgraded metadata rather than accepting compatibility drift

boundaries.behavior_focus: portable diagnostic code, severity, span, and fix-it metadata
boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: diagnostic fixtures are the canonical home for retired spelling, removed flag, and unsupported feature rejection expectations
